body: Hi team, My 5G gateway can't find a 5G cell. The app shows one bar on the 5G indicator. I tried again several times and it didn't help. Let me know what to do.
resolution_steps: Check 5G coverage and cell loading for the installation address.
Ask the customer to reposition the 5G CPE near a window facing the tower and note the SINR/RSRP in the app.
Lock the CPE to the n78 band from the management portal and test again.
Upgrade CPE firmware and reboot.

body: My 5G box loses internet for a few minutes every hour. The indicator on the outdoor unit goes off for a few minutes. I've already tried the basic steps you suggested. It happens every day. Worst experience ever, I'm fed up.
resolution_steps: Check sector congestion on the serving 5G cell during the reported hours.
Review CPE logs for handovers and detach events.
Switch the CPE to a less loaded band or carrier if available.
Log a capacity ticket if sector utilisation is consistently above 85%.
Follow up in 72 hours to confirm stability.
